lrw.text: Lorwyn-Shadowmoor is a twinned plane, and in Lorwyn's age Oona used the Great Aurora to control it, alternating its celestial cycle every 300 years.
The Great Mending then disrupted the cycle, and Oona feared she might be affected by the Great Aurora, so she deployed her second heir, who would become Maralen, into Lorwyn as it neared.

In 4520 AR Maralen accompanied a Mornsong wedding convoy that would have united the Mornsong and Gilt-Leaf tribes, but a swarm of faeries and vines massacred it, and the real Maralen died and was replaced by a faerie impostor.
Meanwhile Ashling began a pilgrimage through Lorwyn searching for the greater elemental of her birth, and the elves' empire dwindled, letting other species gain footholds.

mor.text: Ashling ascended a step on the Path of Flame and could will her flame white, leaving in flame with the elemental after helping free the giants.
She resolved to claim the elemental's power for herself rather than seek its guidance, while Ashling, Brigid and the Vendilion clique found Rhys with a message from Colfenor.

shm.text: Lorwyn gave way to Shadowmoor, the Pendulum Year began as the plane fused, and pockets of Lorwyn sprouted in Shadowmoor before Eirdu and Isilu emerged to control the plane's auroras and bring forty years of peace.

In Shadowmoor, Ashling became the Extinguisher, called the Destroyer, who laid waste to many places until Maralen, Brigid, Captain Sygg and the Source of the Wanderbrine subdued her and Maralen gained the elemental power instead of Oona.
Reduced to a flamekin again, Ashling repented and helped Maralen's party defeat and destroy Oona.

eve.text: Maralen stole Ashling's power with the scroll and the Crescent and challenged Oona, and with Rhys, Ashling and two elementals she destroyed her and became queen of the fae.

Oona's death collapsed the artificial cycles, so the plane entered the Pendulum Year before Eirdu and Isilu restored balance, and the Vendilion clique, the elven monarchs and countless fae and elves perished.
Ashling was freed of her madness, ventured around 4522 to the Primal Beyond to understand the plane's duality, and became a rimekin who can keep those near her in Lorwyn form.
Maralen gave Rhys a moonglove flower to use on her if Oona returned through her, and Rhys became unable to die until then.

ecl.text: In Lorwyn Eclipsed, Oona had been destroyed, ending her control over the cycle of day and night, but her meddling left the plane's aspects bleeding into one another as Eirdu and Isilu awoke from the firmament and eclipsed realms began to appear.
Students from Arcavios were lured through an Omenpath into Lorwyn-Shadowmoor, accidentally woke the moon-headed Isilu in a cave, and watched darkness flood the world and turn day to night.
They met the kithkin Brigid Baeli, and Abigale was carried to the sleeping Eirdu, who led Isilu to its twin and restored balance between night and day.

Meanwhile Rhys confronted Maralen, believing her to be Oona, and cut her with a poisoned dagger, until Oko revealed himself as her brother and went to find Morcant for the dawnglove that could counter the poison.
